<awtsmoosMeluketTranslation heichel="ikar" alias="meluket_translation_en" seriesId="ניסן_meluket" postId="BH_POST_1766518918104_theRebbe_982" batchId="meluket-_D7_A0_D7_99_D7_A1_D7_9F_meluket__BH_POST_1766518918104_theRebbe_982__p004">
  <section v="9">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>Based on this, there are two aspects in the superiority of the Torah of the future, the Torah of Moshiach.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">And based on this, it can be said,</t>
    <t s="1">that regarding the superiority of the Torah of the future,</t>
    <t s="2">the Torah of Moshiach,</t>
    <t s="3">there are two matters.</t>
    <t s="4">One is that then there will be the revelation of the perfection of the Torah from its own essence,</t>
    <t s="5">and the elevation that will then be in the Torah through the elevation of the mitzvos.</t>
    <t s="6">And similarly, regarding the soul,</t>
    <t s="7">in addition to the fact that then the root of the souls themselves will be revealed,</t>
    <t s="8">the soul will also receive the revelation of the superiority of the body</t>
    <t s="9">(the choice of Atzmus in the body).</t>
  </section>
  <section v="10">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>May it be His will that through our actions and service, especially spreading the wellsprings, we merit to learn Moshiach's Torah from his mouth very soon.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">And may it be His will,</t>
    <t s="1">that through our deeds and our service,</t>
    <t s="2">and particularly through the service of "spreading your wellsprings outward,"</t>
    <t s="3">we will merit to study the Torah of Moshiach,</t>
    <t s="4">from the mouth of Moshiach,</t>
    <t s="5">very soon.</t>
  </section>
</awtsmoosMeluketTranslation>

sections.sectionSummaryBrief: Based on this, there are two aspects in the superiority of the Torah of the future, the Torah of Moshiach.

translations.translation: And based on this, it can be said,
that regarding the superiority of the Torah of the future,
One is that then there will be the revelation of the perfection of the Torah from its own essence,
and the elevation that will then be in the Torah through the elevation of the mitzvos.
in addition to the fact that then the root of the souls themselves will be revealed,
the soul will also receive the revelation of the superiority of the body
(the choice of Atzmus in the body).

sections.sectionSummaryBrief: May it be His will that through our actions and service, especially spreading the wellsprings, we merit to learn Moshiach's Torah from his mouth very soon.

translations.translation: And may it be His will,
that through our deeds and our service,
and particularly through the service of "spreading your wellsprings outward,"
we will merit to study the Torah of Moshiach,
